sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Operations in Customs Free Trade Zones

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: U.S.-derived common law corporate statute (modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and the U.S. Model Business Corporation Act), with a constitutionally based Bill of Rights, Marshallese customary law overlay, and an independent High Court and Supreme Court.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986; Amended 2003) — trade and economic relations framework
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA, 2001) — goods trade liberalization
PACER Plus (2017; RMI ratification in force) — trade and development cooperation
U.S. Multilateral Fisheries Treaty (1987, as amended) — access and marine-sector investment framework
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement is currently in force for the RMI

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended), 39 MIRC Ch. 1; Financial Intelligence Regulations 2013; Banking Act 2013 (as amended); Registrar of Corporations AML/CFT Guidelines for Licensed Registered Agents; Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), 36 MIRC Ch. 5.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Nominee_Friendly: beneficial-ownership data is held privately by the licensed registered agent and disclosed to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, Banking Commissioner, Registrar, or law enforcement only on statutory demand; there is no public beneficial-ownership register; nominee directors, nominee shareholders, and physical bearer shares are permissible for non-resident corporations, subject to registered-agent custody.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized AML/CFT UBO Self-Certification and Source of Wealth / Agreement of Funds Declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner acting before a notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (HCCH 1961); RMI consular legalization only where the origin state is not an Apostille Contracting Party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport bio-data pages of each director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / competent authority of the passport-issuing state (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State for notarized true-copy certifications)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Good Standing and register of directors of each intermediate legal-entity shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of each intermediate jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization if the intermediate registry is located in a non-Hague State

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (issued within the last 90 days) confirming FATF-compliant client due diligence by the relationship bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true copy with Hague Apostille, or consular legalization for non-Hague banking jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the RMI licensed registered agent and authorizing incorporation filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate officer / UBO executing under the constituent documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Sections 39 (Incorporation), 42 (Registered Agent), 45 (Registered Office), 50 (Directors), and 53 (First Board of Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Certificate of Incorporation) filed electronically through the RMI Online Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for a non-resident Business Corporation. Share capital may be denominated in U.S. dollars or another permitted currency; no escrow account is required by statute for formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the subscription for its initial authorized shares as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation. RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent appearing in the Articles of Incorporation are adopted as the Corporation's statutory address and agent. RESOLVED, that the persons named as directors in the incorporator's statement are elected as the first Board of Directors. RESOLVED, that the President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed as officers to hold office until the next annual meeting or until successors are elected. RESOLVED, that the Board adopts the Corporation's Bylaws in the form presented, authorizes signing authorities for bank and government filings, and directs the Secretary to effect all registrations, licenses, and permits necessary for operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application via the RMI Online Corporation Registry portal. The proposed corporate name must end with Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, or an approved abbreviation and must not be confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Expedited processing is available on payment of a supplementary fee.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged as deceptively similar, submit a written appeal to the Registrar within 15 days, or file an amended name reservation with a distinctive name and a Consent to Use letter from the existing rights holder if available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporator Appointment and Registered Agent Designation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator (a natural person or corporate entity) executes the Articles of Incorporation and appoints a duly licensed Marshall Islands resident agent. The registered agent must maintain a physical street address in Majuro or Ebeye. The incorporator's powers are exercised by signing the Articles electronically and affixing a notarized signature block where applicable.
required_dossiers: Certified Copy of Incorporator's Passport or Corporate Registry Extract
Power of Attorney if the incorporator is represented by counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent is challenged for non-licensure or defective consent, promptly replace the agent by filing an Amended Statement of Registered Agent with a duly executed new consent, and pay the standard amendment fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Articles of Incorporation together with the incorporation fee and the annual franchise tax first-year prepayment through the RMI Online Portal. The Registrar will issue a Certificate of Incorporation upon verification. The certificate establishes the Corporation's separate legal existence and limited liability shield.
required_dossiers: Payment of Filing Fee and First-Year Annual Franchise Tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or provisional rejection, respond with a corrective filing within 30 days, clarify any deficiency in the Articles, and request expedited reconsideration; failure to cure may require a fresh filing with updated statutory declarations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and Organization of First Board
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Records of the Registered Agent / Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the incorporator or the initial directors must hold an organizational meeting, either physically or via unanimous written consent, to adopt Bylaws, appoint officers, and designate banking signatories. Written minutes or unanimous consent must be recorded in the corporation's minute book maintained by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Written Consent of Incorporator or Minutes of Organizational Meeting
Registered Agent's Record of Directors and Officers
Appointment of Authorized Bank Signatories and Corresponding Signature Specimens
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate records are found incomplete during a certification review, ratify all actions by executing a retroactive unanimous written consent of directors and a statement of correction, then re-file the corrected minutes with the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Share Certificates and Share Register Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Records of the Registered Agent / Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Certify and issue share certificates representing the initial subscribed share capital. Maintain a share register recording the names, addresses, number of shares, and transfer restrictions applicable to each shareholder. The share register must be available for lawful inspection at the registered agent's office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a share issuance is queried for non-payment of consideration or defective endorsement, issue a letter of correction, obtain the shareholder's ratification, and record an amended allotment resolution in the share register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Corporate Tax Exemption Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and Marshall Islands Tax Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Certificate of Good Standing after the first board meeting and obtain confirmation of non-resident Business Corporation tax-exempt status under the RMI Income Tax Act. The Corporation is not subject to income tax, withholding tax, or capital gains tax on non-resident sourced income; no economic substance filing is required for a licensed registered agent-represented entity unless carrying on business in Marshall Islands waters.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Good Standing is withheld due to an unpaid franchise tax or missing annual report, remit the outstanding fee and submit the overdue annual report, then request acceleration of the Good Standing issuance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Investment and Trade Commission; Ministry of Resources and Development (Industrial Licensing Division)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bonded Warehouse Operator License and Free Trade Zone Enterprise Certificate

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Agency of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Limited Environmental Review and EIA Registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with RMI EPA Wastewater Discharge Standards for industrial discharges: biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) not exceeding 30 mg/L, total suspended solids (TSS) not exceeding 50 mg/L, pH within 6.0-9.0, and no untreated hazardous or petroleum waste discharge to lagoon or groundwater. Volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from bonded storage and handling activities must not exceed 50 parts per million (ppm) vapor concentration at the boundary; all fuel and chemical storage must be within secondary containment bunds of 110% capacity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate issued by the Marshall Islands Fire and Rescue Service validating compliance with NFPA-based fire codes, installation and maintenance of fire suppression and emergency lighting, and clear egress pathways; Structural Load Clearance from the Ministry of Public Works confirming the depot facility's design code compliance for warehouse racking, bonded pallet loads, and seismic/wind load resistance; Occupational Workplace Clearance from the Occupational Health and Safety Division covering worker safety training, chemical handling protocols, personal protective equipment, and signage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands, Ministry of Finance – Revenue and Taxation Division (Official government portal: https://www.rmi.gov.mh)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation operating as a Free Trade Zone Bonded Depot is not required to obtain a domestic Taxpayer Identification Number for ordinary income tax purposes, as it qualifies for the Tax-Exempt Zone classification. The statutory procurement SOP is: (i) apply for a Foreign Corporation Registration Certificate from the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act; (ii) submit an exemption confirmation letter to the Revenue and Taxation Division using Form TAX-EX-01, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, articles of association, good standing certificate, and passport copy of the ultimate beneficial owner; (iii) once the exemption is granted, the Revenue and Taxation Division issues an Exempt Entity Registration Number (EERN) which serves as the functional TIN for customs bonded licensing and banking counterparty verification; (iv) processing takes 5-10 business days and is renewable annually by filing a nil-profit declaration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the Business Corporations Act and the Fiscal Concessions Act 2001, an eligible non-resident corporation may file a one-time written election to be designated as a Non-Resident Exempt Corporation (referenced as the 'Exempt Company Election'). No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Marshall Islands domestic law; however, an exempt company may voluntarily elect to be subject to the Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) at a rate of 3% on local-source receipts in order to enter into tax-sparing treaty arrangements or to satisfy counterparty substance requirements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gross Revenue Tax (GRT; a turnover-based sales tax) with customs duty applying at the border; no VAT/GST regime in force
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable to Tax-Exempt Zone operators. In the general local economy, any business with annual gross revenue exceeding USD 25,000 must register for GRT; however, bonded depot operators within the free trade zone are zero-rated and not subject to GRT registration, regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate is imposed for exempt-zone transactions. Nonetheless, all customs-related documentation must be transmitted electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs clearance platform. Bonded warehouse movement records must be filed digitally on a quarterly basis to the Marshall Islands Customs Service, and export declarations must carry a digital signature and be matched to the free trade zone e-ledger.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for the 0% export zero-rating treatment is automatic for goods physically entering and leaving the Free Trade Zone Bonded Depot. The operator must (a) hold a valid Free Trade Zone licence issued by the Marshall Islands Development Authority; (b) hold a Customs Bonded Warehouse permit; (c) maintain separate inventory accounts for zone-origin goods; and (d) ensure that all exported goods leave the customs territory within 180 days of admission to the depot. Offshore services supplied by depot operators to non-resident clients may also be zero-rated where the contract is concluded outside the Marshall Islands and consideration is paid directly from a foreign bank account outside the jurisdiction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Free Trade Zone Inventory Control Slip
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims are subject to retrospective reassessments by the Revenue and Taxation Division for a period of up to six years from the year of export. Civil penalties include a 200% under-declaration surcharge and interest at 1.5% per month. Administrative sanctions include immediate revocation of the bonded depot licence and blacklisting of the responsible customs broker. Wilful evasion is a criminal offence under the Customs Act 1990, carrying imprisonment of up to five years and fines of up to USD 50,000.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: There is no central bank or foreign exchange authority in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; the financial sector supervisor is the Banking Commission of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance. The US dollar is the sole legal tender and clearance ultimately relies on the US payments system, but the Federal Reserve exercises no direct supervisory authority over Marshall Islands-licensed banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands does not issue its own currency and maintains no statutory distinction between current-account and capital-account convertibility. All payments are executed in US dollars, and there are no exchange-control restrictions on profit remittance, dividend distributions, loan repayments, or capital repatriation for non-resident shareholders. Legal and administrative obstacles are minimal, but practical hurdles include stricter correspondent-bank due diligence on Marshall Islands entities due to jurisdiction reputation and the absence of a formal central-bank guarantee facility.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory requirements for the surrender, conversion, or mandatory repatriation timelines for export proceeds. Bonded-depot operators may retain export earnings in US-dollar accounts indefinitely. No conversion obligation exists because the US dollar is the domestic currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational/Commercial Transaction Account (USD current account) for business operations and trade settlements

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational/Commercial Account (USD) and trade finance account; eligible for liquidity support through a US-based parent

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. The Marshall Islands has no dedicated EMI, digital-bank, or e-money licensing framework. Offshore electronic money institutions cannot obtain a passported license locally, and any non-Marshall Islands entity holding client funds in the RMI would likely be deemed unlicensed deposit-taking, prohibited under the Marshall Islands Banking Act and Captive Insurance Act principles. An offshore EMI account may be used only for receiving corporate funds if it maintains a genuine USD correspondent relationship, but local regulated-entity payers and dedicated correspondent banks will typically reject a purely virtual-license EMI due to AML and jurisdiction-exposure concerns. Direct clearing for bonded-depot licensees is therefore not viable through unlicensed EMIs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory law mandates a physical appearance for bank account opening, but in practice Marshall Islands commercial banks (especially Bank of Marshall Islands) require at least one signatory director or the ultimate beneficial owner to appear in person at the Majuro or Ebeye branch for an initial KYC interview. Remote opening is theoretically possible for a low-risk non-resident corporation with a pre-existing banking relationship at Bank of Guam, but for a newly incorporated Business Corporation operating in a free trade zone, the enhanced risk tier generally triggers physical due diligence and certified-true-copy verification by a notary public or an RMI consular officer. The account signatories are usually required to produce original passports and proof of address. Corporate board resolutions and power-of-attorney instruments must be notarized and apostilled.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction and beneficial-ownership opacity: Marshal Islands Business Corporations are frequently flagged as shell-company vehicles; the ownership and directorship may be deemed obscured if nominee shareholders are used.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the certificate of good standing from the RMI Business Registry; full corporate register extract showing registered agent and registered office in Majuro; complete beneficial ownership disclosure Form (RMI Beneficial Ownership Register); notarized board resolution identifying all commercial activities; sworn affidavit from each ultimate beneficial owner; evidence that the entity holds a valid Free Trade Zone Bonded Warehouse License issued by the RMI Customs Service; signed trust or nominee disclaimers, if applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Licence and business purpose mismatch: The bank may apply the Medium-Risk_Enhanced tier for bonded-depot operators that also engage in trading or freight forwarding, and may suspect dual-use goods, customs duty evasion, or sanction implications.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the statutory license (ISIC 5210 / NAICS 493110) issued by the RMI Ministry of Finance; customs bonded-depot registration certificate; storage and inventory management contract between the depot and client; six-month business plan stating that revenue is derived solely from storage, handling, and inventory management; provisional list of target clients and counterparties; import/export permits for the bonded commodities; compliance manual aligned with RMI Customs regulations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Significant US-dollar correspondent due diligence: The US dollar clearing rails cause US correspondent banks to impose additive screening on RMI-based entities, especially with non-resident shareholders from high-money-laundering-risk or OFAC-flagged jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed organizational chart for the parent group; economic-substance and tax-residency statement; audited financial statements or initial capitalization proof; customer-due-diligence questionnaire answered per US clearers' guidelines; high-level geographic risk assessment demonstrating no US nexus except USD clearing; written confirmation that the Free Trade Zone depot physically exists in an RMI-designated customs area; confirmation of no nominee bank accounts or third-party payment processors.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections into a Marshall Islands bonded-depot entity are USD-denominated. The compliant routing is a SWIFT MT103 remittance from the ultimate beneficial owner's or shareholder's personal or corporate bank account in the originating jurisdiction to the RMI bank's correspondent account (usually at a US clearing bank), followed by a Fedwire or CHIPS transfer to the RMI bank. The funds are credited to the RMI entity's operational account. The remittance reason code must accurately indicate 'equity injection' or 'shareholder loan' using SWIFT field 70 (Remittance Information). For inward investments, the standard IFM type is 'domestic direct investment' and the beneficiary must provide a board resolution, subscription agreement, or shareholder loan agreement. The RMI bank will require name-match screening of the originating financial institution, proof that the sending entity is not a shell or high-risk entity, and, if the amount exceeds USD 10,000, a Currency Transaction Report. No central-bank approval is needed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for bonded-depot trade settlements are executed through: (1) SWIFT MT103 for direct high-value interbank transfers covering payment to foreign suppliers, freight forwarders, or customs duty service providers; (2) MT202 COV for correspondent-bank head-to-head USD clearing when the receiving bank is outside the US; (3) commercial letters of credit (LC) issued by the RMI bank's US dollar correspondent for importing goods into the bonded depot, with the beneficiary's bank receiving an MT700; and (4) local clearing via the Marshall Islands Clearing System (run by the Bank of Marshall Islands) for domestic payments to RMI suppliers, utilities, and the RMI government. Each outgoing payment must show a valid purpose description matching the goods or service category in the bonded-depot license. The bank will perform sanctions screening against OFAC, UN, EU, and RMI consolidated lists. The lawful use of an internal corporate account for cross-border settlement is not permitted without a separate money-transmitter license.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: No hedging is required for USD/USD exposures; as the RMI is a dollarized jurisdiction, the functional currency for all accounts and contracts is the US dollar.

For non-USD receivables (e.g., from APAC or European supply chains), Marshall Islands corporations may enter into outright forwards with a non-RMI international bank that maintains a USD clearing correspondent; the forward is directly settled in USD through a master agreement.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) are permitted only as an offshore risk-management artifact, not through an RMI licensed bank, because there is no local onshore RMB or other non-USD market; NDF contracts would be cleared through Singapore or Hong Kong and recorded as a hedge of the underlying trade receivable or payable.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps are permissible only for a debt facility exceeding USD 5 million, executed under an ISDA master agreement with a high-grade foreign counterparty; local bond and swap clearing infrastructure does not exist.

Plain-vanilla leveraged or speculative currency swaps are not permitted for a non-resident Business Corporation unless the transaction is backed by a real commercial flow and the foreign counterparty confirms an exemption from the RMI's lack of securities licensing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through July 31 each year (filing window; failure to file by July 31 triggers delinquency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$200.00; continued non-payment or non-filing for 90 days after the July 31 deadline subjects the entity to administrative dissolution and strike-off from the corporate register.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA). Compulsory audit applies only to licensed banking, insurance, or other regulated financial activities; a licensed bonded depot operator may be required to provide certified statements by the FTZ licensing authority or a secured lender.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or US GAAP; no local statutory accounting framework is prescribed for non-resident tax-exempt entities. Books and records must be sufficient to enable true and fair reporting if a financial statement is requested by the Registrar or a regulatory body.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The BCA does not require an annual UBO confirmation filing. Ownership transfers must be reflected promptly in the company's internal registers and any nominee ownership arrangement must be documented in the trust or nominee declaration for production to licensed authorities upon request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$250 – US$850 per annum for a local registered agent and registered office (typical range for a non-resident FTZ-owned holding company)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500 – US$6,500 per annum (not statutorily required; appropriate where the FTZ license, bank, or creditor demands an independent audit of a bonded depot legal entity)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a non-resident Business Corporation licensed as an FTZ bonded depot; 3% Gross Revenue Tax only on non-exempt revenue derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full exemption from RMI income tax and gross revenue tax for trade or business income sourced from the bonded warehouse/free trade zone operation; no capital gains tax; no payroll tax on non-resident personnel; no branch profit tax; no withholding tax on dividends or distributions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Form GRT-1 (Gross Revenue Tax Return) filed through the RMI Tax and Customs Department electronic filing portal; exempt non-resident BCs file an annual Exemption Declaration/Annual Report with the RMI Registrar of Business Corporations
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual for exemption declaration; quarterly only if non-exempt RMI-source gross revenue is earned
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly Form GRT-1 is due within 30 days after each calendar quarter-end; the annual exemption declaration is due within 30 days after the fiscal year-end or on 31 March, whichever follows the applicable law

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Gross receipts from RMI sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All amounts received for services, storage, handling, warehousing and logistics performed in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, excluding FTZ-licensed revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 0 if the BC conducts no non-exempt business activity in RMI and all FTZ revenue is separately shown as exempt

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 - FTZ bonded depot exempt revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue derived solely from the licensed bonded warehouse / free trade zone operation and covered by the FTZ tax exemption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the FTZ licence, customs bonded operator licence, and a revenue allocation certificate signed by the RMI resident agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 - Taxable gross revenue (Line 1 less Line 2)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net amount subject to the 3% gross revenue tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be zero for a properly structured non-resident FTZ BC; any positive amount must be remitted electronically in USD

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late quarterly GRT filing: 5% per month or part of a month, maximum 25%; late payment interest: 1.5% per month; false declaration: 10% negligence penalty or 50% fraud penalty; repeated noncompliance can suspend the FTZ licence

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (RMI imposes no statutory dividend withholding tax; dividends from a non-resident BC are paid gross)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No RMI double tax agreement covers dividend relief. Where the shareholder's home country requires proof of residence, the BC applies to the RMI Tax and Customs Department for a Certificate of Tax Residency/Non-Residence (TRC), attaches the dividend resolution, and files the TRC with the foreign tax authority to support foreign tax credit or exemption
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on royalties and interest; with no DTA network, treaty-reduced rates are not applicable, and the source rate remains nil

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold (USD 0); RMI does not impose a domestic Local File/Master File requirement. If the entity becomes taxable, OECD-aligned documentation must support pricing of intercompany storage, logistics, and IP royalties
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No separate Economic Substance Regulations filing regime applies to non-resident BCs. However, the FTZ bonded depot licence requires a physical warehouse or locker in the FTZ, a licensed customs bonded operator, a resident agent, a registered office in RMI, and books and records maintained in RMI; substance is evidenced by payroll, warehouse lease, inventory records, and customs filing logs

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a zero-revenue or fully exempt declaration while operating an unlicensed bonded depot, or deliberately misclassifying non-zone storage, handling, and logistics fees as FTZ-exempt revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-assessment of unpaid gross revenue tax for the applicable limitation period; late filing penalty of 25%; negligence penalty of 10%; fraud penalty of 50%; monthly interest of 1.5%; revocation of the FTZ licence; criminal fine for wilful evasion of up to USD 50,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign false returns or cause fraudulent exemption claims are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt; courts may pierce the corporate veil and order civil restitution, asset seizure, travel bans, and imprisonment for up to one year per count

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the BC as a mailbox entity without actual bonded warehouse operations, local employees, or licensed customs management while claiming FTZ tax exemption and no RMI-source income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the Business Corporation registration and FTZ licence; forfeiture of the customs bond or comparable security; administrative penalties under the RMI Business Corporations Act and Customs Act; deregistration by the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for customs duties and taxes when the corporation is treated as an agent or alter ego; travel restrictions and director disqualification orders may be imposed

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the bonded depot to invoice fictitious goods, over- or under-invoice inventory, commingle third-party funds with corporate funds, or move untaxed goods into RMI customs territory without duty payment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Criminal Code and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act: fines up to USD 500,000 or the value of the laundered property; forfeiture of assets; licence revocation; imprisonment up to 25 years for organised money laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who direct, consent to, or benefit from the scheme may be prosecuted as principals; personal civil restitution equal to the laundered value plus punitive damages; international travel bans and extradition may apply
